description: This source file extends the Swift Foundation Process class with a method to run the process and read data from a pipe until the end, then wait for the process to exit. It mainly provides a utility function to simplify process execution and data retrieval.

classes.name: Process (extension)
classes.description: An extension to the Swift Foundation Process class adding a method for running the process and reading data from a pipe until complete.

methods.name: runAndReadToEnd(from:)
methods.description: Runs the process, reads all data from the specified pipe until the end, waits for the process to exit, and returns the data as Data object.
